evidence.note: Charcoal serif title on white; soft, low-saturation blue blurred blobs confined to the right edge; blue only on the active nav tab.

Grey arrows plus one blue and one red stroke; check badges are pale-blue fills; white cards on white. The only coloured text is the red bold 'Misaligned reinforcement:' label on a white callout, not on a coloured fill.
Pale-grey server panel with blue-outlined agent dots and grey lines; a bright red dot sits next to a darker red lock icon, two slightly different reds, but both are small marks on neutral ground.
Blue, near-black and red dots and strokes encode agent run, coordinator and sacrificed; the palette stays restrained (three hues on grey/white) with no bright-on-bright pairings.
Three white cards with charcoal and grey text; colour is limited to small blue bullets and the blue kicker '09 · INSIGHTS'.
Charcoal 'Thank you' on white with soft blue blurred blobs, matching the title slide.

rationale: The deck is consistently charcoal and grey on white with one blue accent, which matches the reference pass anchor in spirit. Red appears only as strokes, dots or a short label on white, and no slide pairs one saturated colour against another. The slightly mismatched reds on s-4 are too small to count as clashing.
